messages.subject: micro_USA() function error
messages.body_plain:
Hi All,

     I was running into some issues with trying to get the micro_USA() function (accessed from github) to run. I was hoping to get it running first before changing the code for future climate scenarios.

In the function, spatial = “N:/USA”, and despite changing it I run into several different issues. The most common is the following (using the traceback):

> USA<-micro_USA()

Error in .local(.Object, ...) :

Error in .rasterObjectFromFile(x, band = band, objecttype = "RasterLayer",  :

  Cannot create a RasterLayer object from this file. (file does not exist)

7.

stop("Cannot create a RasterLayer object from this file. (file does not exist)")

6.

.rasterObjectFromFile(x, band = band, objecttype = "RasterLayer", ...)

5.

.local(x, ...)

4.

raster(paste0(spatial, "/PRISM_us_dem_4km_asc.asc"))

3.

raster(paste0(spatial, "/PRISM_us_dem_4km_asc.asc"))

2.

extract(raster(paste0(spatial, "/PRISM_us_dem_4km_asc.asc")), x)

1.

micro_USA()

Downloading the .asc file and trying to extract the raster layer from a direct filepath gets me the following issue:

> USA<-micro_USA()

OVER_QUERY_LIMIT:Madison,Wisconsin

[1] "try 2 ..."

[1] "try 3 ..."

[2018-02-15 11:51:03] Exception: Do not know how to unwrap object: RasterLayer

  at #03. extract.default(raster(paste0("C:/global climate", "/PRISM_us_dem_4km_asc.asc")),

              x)

          - extract.default() is in environment 'R.utils'

  at #02. extract(raster(paste0("C:/global climate", "/PRISM_us_dem_4km_asc.asc")),

              x)

          - extract() is in environment 'R.utils'

  at #01. micro_USA()

          - micro_USA() is in environment 'R_GlobalEnv'

Error: Do not know how to unwrap object: RasterLayer

8.

stop(cond)

7.

throw.Exception(Exception(...))

6.

throw(Exception(...))

5.

throw.default("Do not know how to unwrap object: ", class(x)[1L])

4.

throw("Do not know how to unwrap object: ", class(x)[1L])

3.

extract.default(raster(paste0("C:/global climate", "/PRISM_us_dem_4km_asc.asc")), x)

2.

extract(raster(paste0("C:/global climate", "/PRISM_us_dem_4km_asc.asc")), x)

1.

micro_USA()

I don’t know whether the issue is because micro_USA is not part of NicheMapR v1.1.3 or I do not have access to the appropriate files because I am not affiliated with University of Idaho. I run into similar issues when I try running the micro_aust() or micro_aust_forecast().

Apologies for any ignorance on my part.

Cheers,

Adam

All the best,
Mike
